name: Unearthodox's Exploration Co-Lab 2027
description: Are you working on today's nature-society challenges, while reimagining the systems that caused them? The Exploration Co-Lab is an alternative incubator for edge-walkers: innovators with an ambition for all life on Earth to thrive, but whose work doesn't fit into neat boxes. Over 10-months, we offer thinking space, cohort-based learning, and the customised support that radical ideas need. This open call is for initiatives addressing root-cause issues in humanity’s relationship with nature. We…

name: ChemoStart
description: The pharmaceutical group Insud Pharma has set up an initiative called ChemoStart, designed by Leandro Sigman, which seeks to help startups launch innovative healthcare projects and further the development of projects which are already underway. The programme is open to any human health-related project, including the development of new drugs, precision medicine, artificial intelligence, diagnostics, wearables and any other technology that may be applied in the sector. name: 10th edition Fundación MAPFRE Awards for Social Innovation boosted by IE University
description: Fundación Mapfre is launching the 10th edition of the Fundación MAPFRE Awards for Social Innovation boosted by IE University. This initiative arises from the intention to support innovative solutions that have the potential to make a major social impact. name: Bright Ideas Competition 2027
